_comment: Model catalog. One file, so the picker, the client and the cost table
cannot drift apart (pattern from virattt/ai-hedge-fund llm/registry.py).
Entries here were VERIFIED by actually calling generateContent with a
response_schema, not by reading the model list. Being listed is not the
same as being usable: gemini-2.5-flash appears in models.list() for this
key and returns 404 NOT_FOUND when called.
Pricing is deliberately null. Per-token rates for these models are not
something this catalog can verify, and a wrong rate is worse than no
rate: token counts come back exact from the API and are always reported,
while cost is reported only when someone fills in a rate they have
Re-verify with: uv run python scripts/check_models.py

models._note: Fastest verified: 1.45s for a 2-article structured analysis.
Fallback: a different tier, so it is a different failure domain. 8.3s.
Alias. Not the default: an alias moves under you, which is the opposite of reproducible.
